briefHtml:
NAV S$10,178,005 - reported -0.76%, real approx -0.06% after restatement

  • Biggest mover: Nvidia -4.12% to $156.14, leading SPX -1.92% / Nasdaq -2.49% (correction) into tonight's earnings
  • The one thing: NVDA reports tonight (about 5:20am Wed SGT) with VIX +18.7% at 22.91 and SOX -5.3%; the 10y eased to 5.12% (gate 5.20%, 8bp away) and silver broke to a 1-year low near $47.2 - leveraged silver line now about 1.93x

Markets

  • US Mon: SPX 7,416.59 -1.92%; Dow 51,608.17 -1.41%; Nasdaq 24,509.76 -2.49%; VIX 22.91 +18.7%; 10y 5.12%; DXY 103.58
  • Asia Mon: HSI 23,754 +0.5% (Tencent HK$390.40 +0.98%, Xiaomi HK$29.08 +0.76%); STI 5,183.18 -0.93%
  • Metals: gold about $3,859-3,874 (13-month low); silver about $47.2-47.5 intraday Monday (1-year low; Fri close $48.77)
  • FX: USDSGD 1.289, USDCNY about 6.65

Flags

  • All 8 risk flags are stale-baseline artefacts, magnitudes roughly doubled (GDX -13.7%, SILJ -16.8%, SLVP -16.3%, Tencent -6.7% despite a +0.98% day, CDL -8.7%, silver -9.5%, listed book -4.41%, silver line equity -14.3%)
  • L46.SI Yahoo 404 - 34th session

Insider trades

  • None found (SGX API 404 for the 5th straight trading day; Wing Tai pause 7 sessions; US holdings are ETFs)

Congress trades

  • No new filings dated 11/14-11/16; latest batch filed 11/13: House Republican (OH-2) 19-trade batch - buys AVGO, LRCX, ETN, GOOGL, T; sells PG, HD, V, LLY, KR, AMGN
  • Filed 11/12: GA-12 bought 2 US Treasury notes ($15,001-$50,000 each); TX-37 bought KO
  • Source: Unusual Whales

Trump / policy

  • BIS rule closes China's remote-access chip loophole; licenses now needed for advanced-chip exports to Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Brazil The Hill
  • Huang resigned as NVDA CEO Thursday over Megaspeed-linked scandal; Lutnick to face Senate Banking; Kessler requested by House Foreign Affairs
  • Trump-Xi meeting in Shenzhen Nov 19 Trading Economics
  • Warsh spoke Monday (AI/productivity, no rate signal); FOMC minutes Wed; Waller floated 50bp December hike Admirals
  • Anthropic prices Wed ($70-$78, about $1.3-1.45T), trades Thu as ANT; NVDA is a $10B private-placement buyer Yahoo Finance

Risk

  • Silver line about 1.93x (equity approx S$52,100), down from about 1.99x Friday
  • Binary event risk tonight: NVDA print with VIX 22.91
  • Metals downtrend: gold -15% over 12 weeks; FX about 35% non-SGD at 1.289
  • Concentration: SGX property plus HK tech; STI -4.2% in a month

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • TLT: 10y 5.12%, gate 5.20% 8bp away - deploy AT the gate, not before
  • NVDA/AI bottlenecks: no pre-print trade; beat-and-raise vs about $108bn/74% GM is the trigger to start the 15% sleeve from the ~62% idle cash
  • Real assets: unlevered sleeve only; gold holding 3,850-3,875 through NVDA = first tranche; silver line gets nothing

trumpWatch.title: BIS closes China remote-access chip loophole
trumpWatch.detail: Interim final rule (Mon, effective in 90 days) requires licenses for chips to overseas data centers serving restricted-country firms, and for advanced-chip exports to Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand and Brazil as diversion-risk countries.

trumpWatch.title: Huang fallout hits NVDA and Commerce
trumpWatch.detail: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO Thursday after the Megaspeed-linked scandal; probe now with DOJ. Lutnick to face Senate Banking; BIS head Kessler requested by House Foreign Affairs. NVDA down about $490B in market cap.

trumpWatch.title: Trump-Xi meeting in Shenzhen Nov 19
trumpWatch.detail: Now a named catalyst in Hong Kong market commentary; same day Anthropic begins trading.

trumpWatch.title: Warsh remarks; FOMC minutes Wednesday
trumpWatch.detail: Fed Chair Warsh spoke Monday at the SF Fed productivity/AI task-force conference (no rate signal expected). October FOMC minutes Wed 2pm ET; Waller floated a possible 50bp December hike. December hike fully priced, debate on size.

trumpWatch.title: Anthropic IPO prices Wednesday
trumpWatch.detail: 825M shares at $70-$78 (valuation roughly $1.3-1.45T) price Nov 18 after close, trade Nov 19 as ANT; $26B concurrent private placement includes Nvidia as a $10B buyer.

trumpWatch.title: NVDA earnings tonight
trumpWatch.detail: Results about 4:20pm ET Tuesday (about 5:20am Wed SGT); street guide about $108bn revenue and 74% gross margin. First print since Huang's resignation.
